unit.why: A single wonder tale about the Kozienice Maggid helping an agunah find her husband through a vision in a bowl of water and obtain a divorce.

stories.start_quote: כבר מפורסם מספרי קמאי עוד מעשה נפלאה
stories.summary_en: An agunah comes to the Kozienice Maggid, who shows her her distant husband in a bowl of water; she snatches his tools from it, travels miraculously to his town 300 parasangs away, and the local rabbi uses the objects to compel the husband, who lives with another woman, to give her a get.
